executive_quality.what: Answer-first, decision-led, low text density, scannable in seconds

academic_quality.what: Evidence sourced, citations + references, hedged claims

storytelling.what: Action titles form an argument (ghost-deck), clear arc

visual_design.what: Consistent theme, hierarchy, whitespace, not text-only

data_visualization.what: Right chart per data slide, key finding annotated, native (editable)

infographics.what: Structural content shown as a process/relationship visual

animation_usage.what: Motion serves pacing; native PPTX timing / interactive HTML

accessibility.what: Readable from the back; contrast; alt text; reduced-motion

audience_fit.what: Density, depth, and tone match the audience profile

decision_readiness.what: A clear recommendation/next-step the audience can act on

anchors.3: present but generic; would pass but not impress
anchors.5: exemplary; a reviewer would hold it up as a model
